study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset. Specifically, they used regional brain volumes from T1-weighted MRI scans and regional SUVR values from AV45 Amyloid PET scans as two input modalities. Both brain volumes and SUVR values were extracted from 66 cortical (Desikan-Killiany atlas) and 24 subcortical regions.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: For training, we selected 248 cognitively unimpaired (healthy control) subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging (ADNI) dataset Mueller et al., 2005 with Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR) = 0 and no amyloid pathology. We used regional brain volumes extracted from T1-weighted MRI scans and regional Standardized Uptake Value Ratio (SUVR) values extracted from AV45 Amyloid PET scans as the two input modalities for our model

answer.ADNI: normative training, holdout evaluation, and disease cohort testing

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ADNI was used for: (1) Training the normative model with 248 cognitively unimpaired healthy controls (CDR=0, amyloid negative); (2) Holdout evaluation with 48 separate healthy controls; (3) Testing on 726 amyloid positive AD spectrum (ADS) individuals across different AD stages (preclinical CDR=0 A+ N=305, CDR=0.5 N=236, CDR>=1 N=185).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: For training, we selected 248 cognitively unimpaired (healthy control) subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging (ADNI) dataset... For model evaluation, we used 48 healthy controls for a separate holdout cohort and a disease cohort of 726 amyloid positive AD spectrum (ADS) individuals across the following AD stages: preclinical stage with no symptoms (CDR = 0, A+)(N = 305), (b) CDR = 0.5(N = 236) and (c) CDR >= 1(N = 185).

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative model was trained on 248 healthy controls (cognitively unimpaired, CDR=0, amyloid negative) from ADNI. An additional 48 healthy controls were used as a separate holdout cohort for evaluation. Overall-phase (training + holdout) = 248 + 48 = 296.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The main manuscript does not report age statistics for the healthy control cohort used for normative model training. Although the supplementary materials mention age ranges (47-91 years for one-hot encoding), specific mean, SD, or other age statistics for the 248 training or 48 holdout healthy controls are not provided.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: After this transformation, each subject had an age vector with 44 positions, where each position corresponds to a year within the range of 47-91 years.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: The manuscript does not report sex distribution for the healthy control cohort used for normative model training or evaluation. The model was conditioned on age and sex as covariates, but specific N or percentages for male/female in the 248 training or 48 holdout healthy controls are not provided.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: We conditioned our model on the age and sex of patients, represented as one-hot encoding vectors, to remove the effects of covariates from the MRI and PET features.
